name: Audiogram EQ
author: Fail-Safe
description: Listener-compensating equalizer. Ships blank (0 dB HL); enter clinical audiogram thresholds in the panel. Headphones/speakers presets and optional per-ear L/R gains.

barWidget.description: Apply hearing-loss compensation from an audiogram to general sound output.

schema.label: Bar icon colors
schema.description: status = fixed green/red for ON/OFF. theme = accent when on, muted when off (follows your Omarchy theme).
